extensions: One marked node 11, with each old inner node below, above or incomparable. Keep the induced old order EXACTLY. All new-to-collar relations are as in PR 295. Mark is counted in the growth law only; dynamics uses the unmarked four-node inner order.
screen: Enumerate every transitive assignment for each parent, identify unmarked child isomorphisms separately, apply the unsupplemented PR 295 scalar admissibility rules. Never assign a readout to an obstructed history.
primary: Test the unfiltered positive uniform child law for definability. Conditional comparisons: restrict to the exact admissible sector within each parent, then split each parent's own 1/2 according to (A) equally weighted marked admissible extensions or (B) equally weighted distinct unmarked admissible shapes within that parent. For both parents replace fraction lambda of its own amplitude weight; do not interpret such consistency as physical amplitude consistency.
special: For the single comparable-to-neither-inner-node chain lift of PR 295 keep the other parent exactly at 1/2. Evaluate at total new weight 1/3 against published global-uniform allocation and at 1/2 (replace the chain fully).
gates: Inherit PR 295 two relative level-TV bounds 10%, signed contrast half-L1 bound 25%, unchanged sign. Compare to F2. Record first gate loss along each mixture; scan each admissible deterministic parent-child pair at full replacement for witnesses. Pair scans give witnesses, not unrestricted extrema.
all_weights: Additionally bound a uniform interval around lambda=0 by convexity/polarization for all admissible within-parent allocations. Separate this conservative sufficient bound from actual example crossings.
quadrature: Normalized Gauss-Legendre (inner, outer per lobe) = (32,6), (48,8), then (64,10) or (80,12) on unconverged branches. Require max normalized-lobe amplitude change <3e-10 and final same-design outcome comparison <5e-12; otherwise identify as unresolved. These are empirical precision checks.
controls: Compare base probabilities to PR 295, reproduce its original single-lift equal-weight result; verify input-order counting by independent 4-node enumeration; direct low-order 4D quadrature and relabelling, phase, plus/minus lobe dephasing identities. Estimate numeric uncertainty honestly.
